name: Cargo Outbound Process
purpose: Purpose: Bidders to demonstrate the cargo outbound processes as per documentation provided from acceptance to ramp outbound to ensure the capability of the system is aligned with the operational requirement of MABKargo.
situation: The system should be able to process the commands required for each operational processes and integrate with existing Logistics Management System (LMS) as the primary interface.
demonstration:
Key capabilities to be demonstrated include:
1. Acceptance Process
2. Build Up Process
3. Storage Process for Outbound
4. Ramp Outbound Process
5. Irregularity Handling
output:
1. Integrated system between Warehouse Management System (WMS) & Logistics Management System (LMS) for Outbound Cargo Process. 
2. Full demonstration of cargo outbound processes aligned with general air cargo process OR MABKargo's current processes.
evaluation: Alignment, Process, Understanding of Air Cargo Process

steps.title: Create outbound shipment
steps.action: Create booking and AWB context

steps.title: Request empty BINA / BOXA
steps.action: Send retrieval command with media type, quantity, output lane and final location

steps.title: Retrieve empty media
steps.action: Validate destination and create ASRS transport task

steps.title: Acceptance & loose cargo storage
steps.action: Receive, weigh, assign media and put-away accepted loose cargo

steps.title: Store intact ULD
steps.sub: ULD / IHCA, UWS weight and location
steps.action: Receive intact ULD and update exact final location to LMS

steps.title: Build-up retrieval
steps.action: Retrieve BINA, BOXA, ULD or IHCA to build-up workstation

steps.title: ULD build and final weighing
steps.action: Complete build-up, transfer to TTV and post final UWS weight

steps.title: Ramp outbound retrieval
steps.action: Retrieve ULD to ramp conveyor and display ULD + flight number

steps.title: Close outbound movement
steps.action: Return final location, status, weight and complete event chain

name: Reporting Preparation
purpose: Purpose: Bidders to produce the reports required in the documentation given to ensure the system has the capabilities to provide transparency to MABKargo for its machine availability and performance.
situation: The system must provide comprehensive reporting capabilities that enable operational transparency, support proactive maintenance planning, optimize resource utilization, and facilitate management decision-making through reliable and exportable reports.
demonstration:
The bidder shall demonstrate the system's capability to generate, configure, filter, schedule and export the following reports:
1. System Performance Report
2. Machine Availability Report
3. Machine Fault Analysis Report
4. Machine Health Report
5. Inventory Report
6. System and Machine Utilization Report
7. Optimization Report
Report parameter selection, filtering by date/equipment/location, drill-down capability, dashboard visualization (if available), scheduled report generation, and export to common formats (PDF/Excel/CSV) should be demonstrated.
output:
1. Reports are generated accurately using historical data if available, or using data the captures the operational efficiency of Cargo Terminal Operators. 
2. Users are allowed to schedule or automate recurring reports generation for MABKargo's utilization.

steps.title: Select report family
steps.action: Choose report and date / equipment / location parameters

steps.title: Filter and drill down
steps.action: Apply filters and inspect supporting machine or inventory transactions

steps.title: Visualize trends
steps.action: Render KPI, trend and exception visualizations from dynamic data

steps.title: Schedule recurring output
steps.action: Create automated report schedule and recipient list

steps.title: Export evidence
steps.action: Download report data and preserve filter / generated-at metadata

name: Maintenance Readiness
purpose: Purpose: Bidders to provide the system that related on maintenance which include the graphical user on the maintenance strategy, planning and decision as well.
situation: The system must be able to provide the maintenance strategy and planning. The strategy include to optimize the resources and make sure the availability of the machine is sustain to avoid jeopardize to the operations.
demonstration:
The bidder shall demonstrate the system's capability to plan and strategize the maintenance to optimize the resources align with the machine availability. It is include the following capability:
1. Strategy on Maintenance Optimization
2. Maintenance Planning Upon Breakdown
3. Equipment Availability Calculation on Service Level Availability
output:
1. System able to planning the maintenance accordingly without jeopardize the operations
2. The system interface have a friendly graphical

steps.title: Inspect machine health
steps.action: Review health scores, counters, inspections and trend signals

steps.title: Inject breakdown
steps.action: Record fault, affected cargo task, downtime start and severity

steps.title: Plan maintenance response
steps.action: Select technician, spare, service window and alternate routing

steps.title: Recover equipment
steps.action: Complete repair, safety checks and return machine to service

steps.title: Calculate availability
steps.action: Calculate uptime / planned time and show downtime evidence

steps.title: Publish management pack
steps.action: Generate daily, weekly and monthly performance / fault reports

name: System Integration Planning
purpose: Purpose: Bidders to present the system integration planning to ensure that seamless integration is proposed for enhanced operational efficiency  within MABKargo's warehouse.
situation: The system must have the capabilities to process the commands directed from the Logistics Management System (LMS) to ensure that the cargo handling processes are per the functional requirement. The system must also be able to integrate with current LMS and act as an executor for the commands and record the movements of the cargo vice versa.
demonstration:
Key capabiltiies include: 
1. Full integration with Logistics Management System (LMS). 
2. System must be able to integrate with the MH Internal Systems Scope.
3. Integration planning proposed must be viable for operations on day to day basis.
output: 1. A fully integrated system with current Logistics Management System (LMS)  acting as the interface and the Warehouse Management System (WMS) acting as the executor.

steps.title: Show target architecture
steps.action: Explain interface ownership and command / status boundaries

steps.title: Send LMS command
steps.action: Create idempotent command with AWB, media, source, target and priority

steps.title: Validate and execute
steps.action: Validate payload, location and equipment before task creation

steps.title: Return actual status
steps.action: Publish acknowledged, in-move, arrived and milestone events to LMS

steps.title: Demonstrate failure recovery
steps.action: Simulate interface error and recover through monitored retry / replay

steps.title: Confirm implementation plan
steps.action: Show delivery phases, ownership, testing and cutover approach
